WHAT: FN coordinator state machine now reads all keybind settings and routes dynamically instead of assuming bare FN = PTT and FN+key = toggle.

WHERE: src-tauri/src/features/hotkeys/service.rs

HOW:
- handle_fn_key_event: checks push_to_talk_keybind, toggle_keybind, command_mode_keybind == "FN"
- handle_shortcut_event: checks FN+key against all three keybinds, fires correct action
- check_fn_hold_action: routes to PTT/toggle/command based on which is mapped to "FN"
- New ToggleRecordingActive state: FN release does NOT stop toggle (unlike PTT)
- FnHeld now has was_toggle_active: bool — second FN hold stops toggle instead of starting

WHY: Users couldn't swap PTT and toggle because coordinator assumed fixed mapping. Now any action can be bound to bare FN or FN+key.

GOTCHA:
- Bare FN actions use 300ms delay (language switch protection)
- FN+key actions are instant (no delay needed — macOS already knows it's not a language switch)
- During ToggleRecordingActive: only the toggle keybind or Escape can stop it
- Bug found and fixed: bare FN = CommandMode was completely missing — added alongside PTT/toggle in all three handlers
